enabled.Name: Track needs
enabled.Hint: Turn the timers and chat cards on or off. The dashboard keeps working either way.

postCards.Name: Post chat cards to the GM
postCards.Hint: When a need comes due (and when it becomes overdue), whisper a card with action buttons to the GM.

soonHours.Name: "Soon" warning (hours before due)
soonHours.Hint: How many hours before a need comes due the dashboard starts highlighting it.

restHours.Name: Hours without a long rest
restHours.Hint: After this many hours without a long rest the character is due for rest, and every further hour needs a Constitution save. Default 24.

restSaveDc.Name: Constitution save DC for missed rest
restSaveDc.Hint: DC of the hourly save once the rest limit is exceeded. Default 10.

Dashboard.Title: Party Needs
Dashboard.Empty: No characters to track. Set a primary party in the dnd5e Group sheet and add the player characters to it.
Dashboard.FooterParty: Tracking the members of the primary party "{party}". Double-click a name to open the sheet.
Dashboard.FooterNoParty: No primary party is set, so every player-owned character is tracked. Set one in the Group sheet to limit it.

rested.rest: Take a long rest (opens the rest dialog)

save.rest: Roll the Constitution save for missed rest

toggle.auto: Automatic (by race). Click: does not need this
toggle.exempt: Does not need this. Click: needs it
toggle.needed: Needs this. Click: back to automatic

Card.LimitLeft: The time without food runs out in {time}.
Card.LimitReached: The time without food has run out.

Hint.water: Drank only half the ration? Instead of the penalty, roll a Constitution save, DC {dc}.
Hint.rest: From the next hour on: a Constitution save, DC {dc}, every hour; a failure is 1 exhaustion.
Hint.restSaves: Saves to roll: {n}. DC {dc}; every failure is 1 exhaustion.

Hint.food: What does {actor} eat? Items of the Food type are listed.
Hint.water: What does {actor} drink? Items of the Food type are listed.

Remove.food: Also remove one exhaustion level given for hunger
Remove.water: Also remove one exhaustion level given for thirst

Chat.ExhaustionRemoved: One level of exhaustion is gone.

Penalty.rest: {actor} is worn out from lack of rest: +{n} exhaustion (level {level}).

Notify.GmOnly: Only the GM can do this.
Notify.Failed: The action failed. See the console (F12) for details.
